```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
library(scml)
library(torch)
library(luz)
library(ABAData)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```



# Train a classifier on iris dataset
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
ds <- list(x=data.matrix(iris[1:4]),y=iris$Species)

fm <- nn_cell_scorer |>
  setup(
    optimizer = optim_adam,
    metrics = list(
      luz_metric_accuracy()
    ),
    loss = nn_multi_margin_loss(margin=1)
  ) |>
  set_hparams(colnames(ds$x),levels(ds$y)) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=0,lr=0.001) |>
  fit(
    epoch = 300L,
    data = ds,
    valid_data = ds,
    accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
    callbacks = list(
      luz_callback_lr_scheduler(lr_lambda,verbose=TRUE,function(epoch) {0.1^(((epoch * 4L) %/% 150L) %% 4L)}),
      luz_callback_prune("layer1.linear.weight",n=1,at_epoch=149L)
    )
  )
#luz_save(fm,"model.luz")
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
plot(fm)
```


```{r eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#rec <- lr_finder(fm,ds,accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE))
predict(fm,ds,accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE))$max(dim=2)[[2]] |> 
  as_array() |>
  table(iris$Species)
```



# Train a classifier on allen dataset


```{r eval=FALSE}
sce_mouse <- ABAMouseSSv4("/mnt/Data/Bioinfo_platf/wyss_project/docker_envi/Rpackages/data/ABAMouseSSv4/")
```



```{r eval=FALSE}
sce_set <- sce_mouse[, 1:10000]
sce_set <- scuttle::logNormCounts(sce_set, BPPARAM=BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 10))
```



```{r eval=FALSE}
train <- sce_set[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_set)[2]), size = dim(sce_set)[2]*0.7)]
test <- sce_set[, !colnames(sce_set) %in% colnames(train)]
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
#.getbatch is not working
train_ds <- delayed_dataset(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.numeric(as.factor(train$subclass_label)))
test_ds <- delayed_dataset(x=t(logcounts(test)), y=as.numeric(as.factor(test$subclass_label)))
```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
dl <- train_ds |> dataloader(batch_size = 300)

dl$.length()
```


```{r warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
fitted <- nn_cell_scorer |>
  setup(
    optimizer = optim_adam,
    metrics = list(
      luz_metric_accuracy()
    ),
    loss = nn_multi_margin_loss(margin=1)
  ) |>
  set_hparams(feature_names=rownames(train), class_names=train$subclass_label) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=0,lr=0.001) |>
  fit(
    epoch = 300L,
    data = train_ds,
    valid_data = test_ds,
    #accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
    callbacks = list(
      luz_callback_lr_scheduler(lr_lambda,verbose=TRUE,function(epoch) {0.1^(((epoch * 4L) %/% 150L) %% 4L)}),
      luz_callback_prune("layer1.linear.weight",n=1,at_epoch=149L)
    )
  )
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
plot(fitted)
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
predict(fitted, test_ds ,accelerator = accelerator(cpu = TRUE))$max(dim=2)[[2]] |> 
  as_array() |>
  table(test$subclass_label)
```
